subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper own crawl-remote production deployment with administrator bypass permitted on the protected environment, or must bypass be disabled before rollout?
rationale: Code review supports the implementation mechanics, but only repository owners can authorize this cross-repository production mutation boundary, its permanent operator policy, and the live credential and recovery assumptions.

options.title: Disable bypass, then roll out
options.body: Turn off administrator bypass, verify the environment-only token and crawl-remote contract, then capture redacted dormant rollout and recovery evidence.

options.title: Accept controlled admin bypass
options.body: Explicitly document and accept that repository administrators can override the independent-review gate before production enablement.

options.title: Keep deployment separate
options.body: Retain production deployment in crawl-remote or a dedicated operations repository if ClawSweeper should not own this mutation boundary.

recommendation.title: Disable bypass, then roll out
recommendation.body: Turn off administrator bypass, verify the environment-only token and crawl-remote contract, then capture redacted dormant rollout and recovery evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged ownership of the repository's workflow, credential, mutation, and release boundaries and are best positioned to authorize a new production control plane.
